hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,sys,pathlib; raw=sys.stdin.read() or "{}"; data=json.loads(raw); ti=data.get("tool_input") or {}; tgt=ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("path") or ""; n=os.path.basename(tgt); is_master=bool(tgt) and (n.endswith("_MASTER.xlsx") or n=="master.xlsx" or n.endswith("-master.xlsx")); p=pathlib.Path(tgt) if is_master else None; sidecar=(p.parent/("~$"+p.name)) if p else None; blocked = bool(sidecar and sidecar.exists()); sys.stderr.write("BLOCKED: Excel/LibreOffice owner-lock present at "+str(sidecar)+chr(10)) if blocked else None; sys.exit(2 if blocked else 0)'
